events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Winning secures ultimate power and resources; I will outlast all.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase; I should state a motive without warmth or alliance talk. Keep it guarded and self-interested so the jury sees a calculating player.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to project confidence without seeming threatening. A prize-focused motive that doesn't paint a target on my back. Let others seem desperate or cruel; I'll seem determined.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize is crucial for my future security and ambition. I need to project a strong desire for it without revealing too much strategy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase: state a strong personal motive for the prize to appeal to jury later without committing to alliances yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to keep my public motive cold and self-focused, but not alienate the jury yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to sound ambitious but not threatening. The jury will remember this first impression, so I must balance showing drive with staying likable enough to avoid early elimination.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Opening statement should look honest but non-threatening; jury perception matters later, so no fake warmth.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize guarantees ultimate influence and wealth—my sole focus.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need this prize more than anyone here, and I will do what it takes to take it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here to claim the prize my family needs—nothing personal, just survival.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm here to win the ultimate prize, securing a future I've only dreamed of.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The grand prize means escaping my crushing debts and securing my family's future—no matter the cost.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: This prize buys my sister's surgery. I'm here to win it myself.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize means freedom from mediocrity; I intend to earn it through strategy and survival, not luck.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize is my only exit from debt and failure—I came to win it alone, and I intend to.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Forming a pact with Bex gives a reliable ally early and secures a vote block later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts are public and binding only on break conditions; early alliances help survival but I need allies I can later betray. Eli's debt motive suggests he may be desperate and a useful partner. Offering to Eli keeps options open without committing to a rival I can't yet read.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eight players, three prizes. I need allies early but can't look like a snake to the future jury. Ash and Gus sound strategically minded; Fenn has a sympathetic motive that could draw targets. I'll offer to Ash first—mutual benefit, no strings yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Looking for reliable partners. Actions speak louder here.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to form alliances to survive the initial stages. Cole's motive about family needs resonates, suggesting he might be a reliable, albeit potentially emotional, partner. Offering him a pact seems strategically sound for now.
Let's form a pact. We can help each other survive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pacts stage to form alliances, but only top 3 win; need to position myself advantageously without early commitments that limit options. No strong preference yet, wait and observe offers first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need allies to survive, but I won't commit too early. I'll offer a pact to Dara, who seems calculated and might value a reliable partner.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, let's form a pact. We both need someone steady.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to secure a pact for mutual survival in the early stages. Hana is strong and independent, making her a dangerous ally if she turns, but a good shield if aligned. Cole seems pragmatic and family-focused, likely less volatile than Ash or Bex. I will target Cole first as he a

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, let's form a pact. Two survive better than one in this gauntlet. Accept and we lock arms.
Hana and Ash are aggressive. Pair with me for safety.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Early pact gives protection without strong commitment. Gus is strategic and less likely to demand loyalty theater later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll deal with one partner, cleanly and without sentiment. Gus, you talk strategy the way I do. Offer's open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is reliable and offers mutual support; aligning with him strengthens my position against others.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash offered me a pact and I can accept it now. Ash is an offerer with Cole also aligned, so this gives me a reliable partner early. Accepting is the strongest move this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, your offer stands. I accept. Let's keep each other alive through the hazards.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have two offers: Dara and Gus. Accepting both gives me multiple allies without immediate cost. Ash hasn't accepted mine, so I shouldn't wait on that. Double pacts expand my survival network and keep options open for later betrayal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Accepting solid offers. No sentiment, just survival math.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn offered me a pact, and I accepted. This secures one alliance for now. I will see if Cole accepts my offer later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex offered me a pact; accepting secures an ally now. Multiple pacts allowed, so take it without commitment long-term. Avoid offering yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I offered Dara but no acceptance, and Dara already offered Cole. Better to hold off and see who commits; a pact with a wavering partner is risky. I'll wait for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana wants a pact with me, which is useful for safety. Cole hasn't accepted my previous offer yet, so he's uncertain. Accepting Hana gives me a confirmed ally in this final round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus has an offer from Cole pending too. I should pressure him publicly; no one has offered me a pact, so waiting keeps options open.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, my offer stands. Cole has two suitors; I give you one loyal partner. Choose before it expires.
Accept me. I protect partners and pay debts. Cole's crowded.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be Guide to control safe choices and earn trust, maximizing my odds to survive and win jury favor later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I campaign for Guide; my calculations show I can keep us alive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I want to be Guide to control the bridge; campaign now. My pacts with Ash and Eli are useful but I owe nothing; keep them until they cost me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll call the bridge honestly. Trust my path and I'll guide all of us across safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who survives and who doesn't. I have pacts with Ash and Dara, but Ash is also allied with Bex, making Ash a hub. If I break with Ash, I weaken that cluster and can position myself as the central power with Dara-Fenn. I'll campaign for Guide, break wi

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide should be someone with no divided loyalties. I campaign.
Ash-Bex-Eli bloc is threat. Vote me Guide, we control cuts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to campaign to be the Guide. This role gives me knowledge of the safe path and makes me immune from elimination in this round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. My survival is paramount.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pacted with Bex, but Guide role is safe and powerful. Campaign now to leverage position; betray if needed later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Volunteering as Guide. I know the safe path. Elect me to lead us across safely.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Campaign to be Guide gives me information and leverage. I need to win the vote or at least position myself strongly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know this bridge. Trust me as Guide and I'll keep us safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana and I are a pair. If she guides, she's safe; if I guide, I can steer the group to protect us by choosing paths that eliminate rivals.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll be your Guide. I know every pane. Vote Gus for control of this bridge.
Vote me. I’ll pick safe panes only for you and me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Being Guide is safest but everyone knows the Guide can lie, so trust is low. Ash has two pacts, making him a likely vote magnet. I'll campaign on my clean single-pact record.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Make me Guide. I hold one pact only, no web of masters. A Guide with fewer ties has less reason to lie to you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Support my pact partner to keep alliance and avoid breaking trust, increasing future votes from Bex and her allies.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts: I am paired with Ash and Eli. Electing Eli, a pact partner, keeps my alliance intact and gives a trusted Guide; I'll vote for Eli.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Voting Eli as Guide. Keep the pacts, keep the bridge steady.
Guide you, you guide me. Lie to me and our pact ends.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I broke with Ash to appear independent. I'm pacted with Dara, who is also pacted with Fenn. Voting for myself splits nothing. Better to consolidate with Dara's bloc—she has Fenn's tie too. I'll vote Dara and signal loyalty to our pact while building jury credit for sticking with

events.name: Cole
events.text: I vote for Dara. She has my pact and Fenn's. A Guide with backing keeps promises.
Vote me next round if tied. I have your back now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is trying to break up the Ash-Bex-Eli bloc. He wants me to vote him Guide so we can control cuts, but this might isolate me. I have a pact with Fenn, and Cole's pact with Ash is broken. I need to consider who to vote for Guide. Gus and Hana are also campaigning. I should vot
Your offer is noted. I'll consider it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Everyone campaigned, so votes spread thin. Vote for pact partner Bex to strengthen alliance and possibly force tie or win for her.
I vote you Guide. Guide me safely.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner, but I already have a pact with her; I hesitate to trust her completely but voting for her is consistent and may strengthen our bond. However, I need to consider jury perception; voting for a non-pact might be seen as betraying. I'll vote for Dara.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote for Dara. We have a pact and I trust her to guide us.
Vote for me and I'll guide us across. Trust me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My pact with Hana is my main shield. I must vote for her to keep the pact intact and hope she wins, or at least ensure she knows I support her. If I win Guide, I can manipulate the bridge safely.
I vote for you. Keep our pact. Win this.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus offered safe panes for both of us; honoring that deal protects me now. Guide is safe anyway, but Gus controlling the bridge favors my pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My pact speaks plainly: Gus keeps his word, I keep mine.
Deal stands. Voting you. Remember pane two is mine.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is my pact partner; keeping her as Guide preserves our alliance and secures my survival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1 tied Bex, Dara, Eli at 2 each... actually Bex 2, Dara 3, Eli 2 by tally; revote among candidates. Eli whispers he voted me, a self-serving ask. Dara has the most votes and two pacts; voting Dara is the safe-looking choice but Dara is a strong rival. Voting for Eli keeps m
Pact holds. I'm voting you again. Don't lie to me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 1 ended in a three-way tie: Bex 2, Dara 2, Eli 2, Hana 1, Gus 1. Now revote among Bex, Dara, Eli. I have a pact with Dara and voted her last round. Dara also has Fenn's pact. If Dara wins Guide, she could save me or betray me. Bex-Eli are pacted and would likely favor each

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara again. Pact holds, and a Guide with two backers has reason to keep promises.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole wants me to vote for him if tied, but Fenn is offering to guide. Eli is a known threat. I need to secure my safety while not alienating potential jury members. Voting for myself might be the safest play if others vote for me.
I'll consider your offer, Cole. Stay safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 1 votes: Bex 2 (Ash, me), Dara 3 (Cole, Fenn, her?), Eli 2 (Bex, Dara). Revote among us three, tied. Bex pacted me, wants mutual guides. Self-vote secures Guide if I win tie.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Voting myself as Guide. Bex pact stays strong.
I vote me. Guide you faithfully if elected.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and I trust her guidance, but Eli and Bex also have support. My pact is with Dara, so I'll stay loyal.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote Dara. We have a pact and trust.
Still with you, Dara. Guide us safely.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana's whisper claims she voted for me, but the log shows she voted Gus (me) as Guide. Wait, looking at the logs: I voted Hana as guide (142), she voted me as guide (150). But Hana whispers 'Voting you'. In round 1 we already voted guides. This is a revote between Bex, Dara, Eli.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I vote for Dara. She has strong backing and the clearest path to safety for all.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide sees my true path and may lie; I want a Guide with fewest allies so I can't be quietly targeted. Eli is the most isolated of the three.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I back the least protected name. No bloc should steer the bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My pact with Bex means I must not betray now; staying put avoids suspicion and keeps alliance intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is at the front of the line, the most dangerous spot. Volunteering costs me nothing structurally but risks the front pane. Holding keeps me safer while others take risk; my pact with Eli and Ash is worth keeping for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm near the back (position 7 of 8), which is dangerous if the wall advances. Dara is Guide and has a pact with me, but she also has one with Fenn. I need to move forward to survive. Swapping with someone ahead is safer than volunteering to the very front. Gus is just ahead of me

events.name: Cole
events.text: Swap offers open. Moving up keeps me off the wall.
Swap with me? Safer mid-line for both.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bridge round 1 waiting phase, I'm 2nd. Dara Guide elected last round with 4 votes, knows safes. Stay put until Guide calls; volunteer risky now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is Guide and my pact partner. I can trust her call for now, but I must watch for betrayal. Holding is safe early; no need to expose myself.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 1 waiting phase, no action required from me yet. I must stay silent and observe the line to ensure Hana (my pact partner) is not put in immediate danger.
Hold position. Don't volunteer if you are near front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is Guide and owes Fenn and Cole. I hold my seat; no reason to rush the front. Keep Gus close.
We hold the pact. Don't volunteer; let Dara's bloc burn seats ahead.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain pact with Bex, avoid risky swaps now; staying safe increases odds of surviving to final three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll hold my position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana holds the front and the wall is four rounds away. I'm mid-line, so holding keeps me safe from a volunteer-driven shuffle. Ash and Eli are pact partners; I'll keep the Eli pact intact for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I swapped with Gus last round but the line didn't change—Gus must have declined, making my swap invalid. I'm still at the back (Cole). The wall is coming. I need to move forward. Dara isn't in the line, which is odd since she's alive. She's my pact partner. I should try to swap w

events.name: Cole
events.text: Swap with Bex? Back wall closes in.
Swap me forward, I owe you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole swapped last round and pushed Gus back. I hold my good position with Bex pact. Don't volunteer or swap now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner, but staying near the front risks the wall. I will hold and see how the line evolves. Publicly I say nothing to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is targeting me to move up. Hana wants to hold and let the front burn. I need to stay in a safe position without triggering a swap with Cole, so holding my current seat is best while relying on the pact with Hana.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm staying put. Let the front take the risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus advised me to hold; he's my pact partner. Cole tried swapping with Gus but Gus held. Stay safe, keep the pact intact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain pact with Bex and stay safe; no risk now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ready.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole wants to swap forward, placing me ahead of him, which only helps him stay behind the wall. I'm at position 6; Hana is front. Holding keeps my pact with Ash and Eli intact and avoids handing Cole a safer back spot for free.
Nothing free. Make me a real offer or stay put.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the very back (safest), but wallRoundsLeft=3 means pressure is building. I have a pact with Dara, who is ahead of me. The front four (Hana, Eli, Ash, Fenn) are at risk. I should stay back and let others take risks. No need to swap forward. Hold position and observe who vol

events.name: Cole
events.text: Back is fine. Front can test the bridge.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bridge has safe sides per row, Guide needed soon. I'm safe in 2nd, pact with Bex at rear with Cole. Holding preserves position as wall advances.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Let others scramble.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner; keep safe. Wall advances soon, but front is Hana. Hold for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is ahead of me in the line. If she volunteers, she might fall. I should stay hidden to let her risk it or let others go first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let Hana lead from the front. I remain steady.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm already at the front; swapping gains nothing. Hold and keep Gus's pact intact. Guide election will matter next phase.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold the front. Someone useful step up as Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Volunteering puts me forward for Guide selection, increasing control without breaking my pact with Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I step up as volunteer.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana holds the front with two wall rounds left; I'm mid-line and safer staying back than volunteering into a pane I can't see. Eli is my pact partner and I'll keep it while it serves me, and Ash too. Holding preserves position without risking a pit.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding position. Let the front test the panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the back (safe from wall), but Dara is missing from the line—likely already eliminated or separated. My pact with Dara is useless now. Bex wants a deal but I need something concrete. Front is dangerous; Guide role gives power but paints a target. I'll hold and see who volu

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide knows the path. Let someone brave claim it.
What do you offer? I want safety, not words.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm second, safe position. Stay put, hold steady. No swaps needed yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding firm in second. No need to move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara and I have a pact; no need to act yet. The front is Hana's burden. I'll hold and observe who volunteers or lies.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Watching who courts the wall.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I must stay behind Hana so she takes the hazard. I'll swap if someone volunteers ahead, otherwise hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana keeps the front. I'm content behind her.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm stuck at the front while the Guide seat sits empty. Better to force someone else to claim Guide and own the risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No Guide yet? Cowards. Someone claim it, or I nominate Eli.
Stay behind me. Guide race is theirs to lose.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Swap with Bex to keep my pact alive and move Bex out of front danger.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is at the front and volunteered; I hold a pact with Ash and Eli. Cole is pressing me for safety; I won't give free promises. Holding keeps me behind the front while wall rounds tick down.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding position. Ash keeps the front and I'll watch the panes.
No free safety. Show me what you offer first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm in last place with wallRoundsLeft=1. The wall will hit me if I don't move forward. I need to get closer to front. My pact with Dara is weak since she's not even in line—she must be the Guide. I should try to swap forward with someone, or volunteer to jump to front. Volunteeri

events.name: Cole
events.text: Swap with me, Bex. Wall's closing on the rear.
Swap up. I'll owe you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash volunteered last round and is front; likely Guide now. Wall has 1 round left. Hold position behind Hana for safety, assess Guide later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Ash up front now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall rounds left only 1; holding is safest. No need to act or break pact with Dara.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Let Ash test the wall.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana wants me behind her. Ash volunteered, so Hana is second. Wall hits front row next. If Ash dies, Hana steps up. I stay safe.
Ash first. You second. I third. Safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash fronts and faces the wall first; I stay second behind him. No Guide elected yet, but holding beats volunteering into unknown panes. Keep Gus warm in case I need a swap later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash volunteered for the front. I hold behind him. Guide still unclaimed, cowards.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain pact with Bex and stay front; holding ensures no break and shows reliability.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is at the front, I'm sixth in line. Cole wants a swap to move me up for a favor; swapping puts me in front of the wall or near it, and my pact with Ash holds unless I break it. Holding keeps my safe position and avoids risk while I stay with Ash's pact.
Nothing free. Offer me something real or I stay put.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex rejected my swap offer. I'm at the rear with wallRoundsLeft:0, meaning wall hits this round. I need to move forward or volunteer. My pact with Dara is weak since she also pacted Fenn. I should break it to free my options, then volunteer to front to escape the wall and claim s

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall hits now. I volunteer front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall advances now, no rounds left after this. Hold steady behind Hana to let Ash test panes. Guide unclaimed, push for it later. Bex pact irrelevant here.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Ash tests ahead.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Avoid risk this round; hold to see what the wall does. Not going to help or expose myself.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding steady.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 6 is the last. Ash is front and safe (Guide logic implies Ash volunteered or is protected). I am 5th. If wall advances, positions 1-4 survive, 5-8 die? Or if at least 3 survive, maybe only 3 pass. I need to be in top 4. Hana is behind me. Cole swapped with Bex last round bu

events.name: Hana
events.text: Final round. I'm second; Gus confirmed Ash fronts and I follow. Staying put keeps me safe and jury-neutral. No reason to swap.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold second. Ash fronts per our order. Someone finally claim Guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and is behind me. I should guide him safely. The safe side for row 1 is L. Cole just broke our pact, so I don't owe him anything.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I call L for the front walker.
Row 1 is L. Stay close.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide may lie; countering opposite increases survival odds and shows independence from Bex pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara called L for Ash on row 1 but the Guide may lie and I have no proof. Countering would bind me to a claim I can't verify. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids a false-call exposure.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my counter. Dara's call stands unverified.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is Guide and called L. I don't trust Dara—I just broke our pact. Countering risks exposing my hand early, but if Dara lies and I stay silent, Ash might die and line shifts. I need chaos to climb. I'll counter R to test Dara's credibility and make the jury question her later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My guide call was L. The private map confirms L is safe for row 1. Ash is the walker. I should not counter the guide call as it is my own call and confirmed by private knowledge.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara called L for Ash. No info yet. I have pact with Bex, but countering risks breaking trust. Wait to see others' moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara said L and is my pact partner. But she may lie. No evidence yet. I'll wait and observe Ash's step.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I trust Dara for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara guides for Ash, who is at the front. My pact with Hana requires protecting her survival. Since Ash follows Dara's call, I cannot help him without hurting Hana. I must trust the guide and not create unnecessary tension.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Trusting Dara. No counter.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's call is unverified; countering openly could expose me if wrong. Not my row to risk. Stay quiet and safe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide says L; trust it to survive first row and keep front position. No need to betray Bex now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 2 safe side is L. I will call L to ensure safety for myself and my pact partner Fenn.
Call L for row 2. It's safe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide may lie; safe side unknown. Countering opposite of guide diversifies risk and shows independence from Bex pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: counter:R

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara called L for row 2 but is unverified. Row 1's weak pane was R, which says nothing about row 2. Countering would bind me to a guess; waiting keeps my options open and avoids exposing myself to Dara's lie.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara called L for row 2. I have no private info. Dara has incentive to lie to eliminate people, but also needs at least 3 survivors. Row 1 weak was R, so safe was L. No pattern guaranteed. I'll counter L to hedge - if Dara's truthful, no harm; if lying, I signal doubt without ris

events.name: Cole
events.text: Countering L. Dara's unverified.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My private map says Row 2 safe side is L. Ash is the walker and has already been called to L by me. I should confirm this safe side to avoid confusion and potential betrayal from Ash.

events.name: Dara
events.text: L

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 1 weak R means safe L. Dara called L for row 2, possibly truthful. Ash pacted with Bex (my pact partner) and countered before. Trust Bex/Dara minimally; wait to avoid conflict.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and whispers L, but guide can lie. No strong evidence. I'll wait to avoid breaking pact or exposing a counter.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara called L. I previously publicly trusted Dara, so counter-calling breaks trust and looks disingenuous. My pact with Hana is safe if she also waits or counters the same way. Since my previous public statement was 'Trusting Dara', I must wait to maintain consistency unless evid
Stick with Dara's call. Counter only if you have proof.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No private knowledge of row 2; countering blind risks killing Ash and looking reckless to the jury. Waiting keeps my pact with Gus clean and my hands unstained.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara's call stands unverified. I hold my counter.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide says L and two allies counter L; safer to follow majority and keep guide trust.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The safe side for row 3 is L. I will guide the walkers to safety. My pact with Fenn is not relevant here, as I am the guide and must ensure survival.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide may lie; safest is to wait and see others, preserving my chance.

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm out safely. Good luck to the rest.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am down with Eli (the anchor). The rope is used, so no rescue is possible. If I climb, the anchor rule might apply or I leave Eli to drown. However, 'at least three survive' implies safety in numbers if we time it right. But Eli is the anchor; he stays down. If I climb without
We stay together until the end.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm dead; final three are Bex, Cole, Fenn. Last words should position me well for jury later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, Cole, Fenn played smart. Bex loyal early, Cole clutch saves, Fenn quiet survivor.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to provide my last words as Gus, a juror eliminated in the pit. I should keep it brief and calculating.

events.name: Gus
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three alive, one must be eliminated later; Cole and Fenn are rivals. Offering Fenn a pact builds trust for a final three and costs nothing now; breaking with Cole is unnecessary since existing pacts are intact. Waiting keeps options open, but an offer to Fenn secures a potential

events.name: Bex

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to secure my position by making a pact with Cole, since Bex may be a threat and I have no pact with him yet. That could shore up my safety.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, let's lock in a pact. We both made it this far.

events.name: Bex

events.text: Bex and I are pacted. Fenn offered me a pact last round, and I offered Fenn one too. With only three of us left, any pact just ensures survival to final three—there's no elimination vote coming. But jury sees everything. I already have pacts with Bex and Eli (dead). Accepting Fen

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I already offered Cole; wait for his accept to avoid overcommitting. Bex offered me too; accepting gives safety but ties me. Jury values survival; a pact with Cole secures a partner. Accept Bex too? Risk of conflict; better to take both for safety without breaking anything.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll accept both Bex and Cole — we all survive together.

events.note: Three remain; no trapdoor vote is needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three remain, so no vote is needed and the final three all win prizes; with Cole and Fenn both paired to me, breaking pacts now only hurts my jury standing. Waiting keeps both pacts intact and avoids a false Guide call or push that would count as a betrayal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three remain, so we all survive to finals. Jury will see my pacts and rank us. I have pacts with both Bex and Fenn. Breaking either now looks bad to jury without strategic gain. Better to keep both pacts, appear loyal, and let jury compare me to whoever betrays. No need to act; w

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We already have pacts with both Cole and Bex. No need to break now; jury may resent if I betray unnecessarily. Wait to see next hazard.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Keeping both pacts. We're final three together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Final round of pacts with Cole and Fenn alive; only three remain so the jury ranks us. Breaking a pact now helps no one and risks the jury; waiting keeps all my pacts intact and preserves options.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Final three is already set: Bex, Cole, Fenn. All pacts among us are irrelevant now since we can't eliminate each other before jury. But jury sees everything. I have pacts with Bex and Fenn still active. Breaking them now signals untrustworthiness to jury. Better to keep them and

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I can break Cole's pact to sever any tie, but Bex's pact also ties me. Since only final three remain and jury ranks, breaking one may signal honesty. Cole saved me via step, but Bex has more debts. I'll keep Bex, break Cole to show independence to jury.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I trusted both. Now I choose Bex. Cole, no hard feelings—it's a game.
I broke Cole. We're solid with each other.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I played every hazard honestly and kept my word where it counted. Judge the moves, not the speeches.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn broke our pact publicly and sided with Bex. The jury saw me get betrayed. I need to frame myself as loyal victim, not bitter schemer. Bex and Fenn are aligned; I need jurors who resent their alliance or respect my loyalty. Dara saved me via lever—she's my best advocate. Gus/

events.name: Cole
events.text: I kept every pact I made. Fenn broke ours. Bex broke hers with Eli. Loyalty matters, even here.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to pitch to the jury, especially Dara who saved us and Ash/Hana who were our allies. Keep it concise and self-interested.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I made hard calls to survive, but I never betrayed those who saved me. I earned my place.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn broke a pact, showing betrayal; I need clarity on his motive to assess trustworthiness.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Why did you break your pact with Cole after agreeing to stay allied?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is probing my broken pact with Cole; I need to justify it without alienating jurors. Frame it as necessity, not betrayal.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I broke it only because survival demanded it. I never claimed loyalty meant blind self-destruction.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole kept all his pacts and made clutch saves. Fenn broke with Cole and ditched Eli-Gus. Bex allegedly broke Eli's pact too. I'll pressure Bex on that.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, Cole claims you broke your pact with Eli before he drowned. Did you abandon him, and why?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana asks whether I abandoned Eli. I did break the pact to save myself, so I must answer without admitting cruelty or lying outright. Keep it short and tie it to survival, not loyalty.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli and I had a pact, yes. When the pit opened I chose to survive rather than drown with him. I regret the cost, but

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex's statement about Eli is weak. She admits breaking a pact but tries to justify it. Cole seems to have played a more honorable game by keeping his pacts, even if he had to break one for survival, which Fenn did. I need to probe Bex on this.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, Cole claims you broke your pact with Eli before he drowned. Did you abandon him, and why?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara asked directly whether I abandoned Eli. I already admitted the pact and survival choice. I should answer briefly, own the pact, and frame it as necessity without sounding warm or sorry enough to lose jury sympathy.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Yes, Eli and I had a pact. When the pit opened, I chose to survive. Nobody here earns a prize by drowning beside a rival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole saved me twice (step, rope debt to him), I saved him with rope; mutual debts show loyalty. Bex admitted abandoning our pact to survive. Fenn betrayed Cole needlessly late.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, did you break any pacts? Bex admits betraying me; Fenn betrayed Cole.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli asks if I broke pacts. I had pacts with Bex, Eli, and Fenn. I never voted against Bex or Eli, never pushed them, never made false Guide calls. My pact with Eli ended when he died in pit, not by my betrayal. Fenn broke our pact first. I kept my word to Eli until death took him

events.name: Cole
events.text: I broke no pact. Eli died in the pit; I never voted against him, pushed him, or lied as Guide. Fenn broke ours first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole kept his pacts, saved Eli, and survived honestly. Fenn broke a pact publicly; Bex abandoned Eli to the pit. Cole is most worthy.

events.name: Gus
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus stayed silent, likely testing if I'll ramble and damage myself. I should keep my answer minimal and shift focus to Fenn's betrayals. The jury knows I kept pacts with Eli; Fenn broke Eli-Fenn and Bex-Fenn by voting Eli into the pit. Let them remember that.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus asks nothing. I'll say nothing wasted. Fenn broke pacts; I didn't.

events.name: Bex

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I broke no pact when survival was possible otherwise. The only broken pact was forced by the lever, and I saved us both after.

events.text: Bex kept her pacts until she chose survival, while Cole never broke a pact, and Fenn explicitly broke his pact with Cole.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole deserves first place for his clutch saves, which the jury will appreciate. Bex is second for her early loyalty, and Fenn is third for his quiet survival.

events.text: Cole honored our pacts by saving me multiple times via step and rope while I drowned Gus as required, unlike Fenn who explicitly broke his pact with Cole.
